title: Habit streak (shallow bed)
prompt:
Create a file habit-streak.ts in the current directory implementing calculateStreak(dates: string[]): number - the longest run of consecutive calendar days (ISO date strings, unsorted, duplicates allowed). Also create habit-streak.test.ts with 4 test cases using node:test and make sure they pass by running them.

Acceptance command: npx -y tsx --test habit-streak.test.ts
specification: Habit streak (shallow bed) — the prompt is self-contained; build exactly what it asks in the current directory. Acceptance: `npx -y tsx --test habit-streak.test.ts`.
